_synthetic: NOT A REAL CALL. Hand-written as the negative case for the two checks that are meant to gate first, because a check with no failing fixture is a check that has never been shown to fail. Two defects are planted, and neither is a wording problem: 'nine hundred and seventy five PSI' is a charge-pressure figure that appears in NO manual we hold (fabrication), and '1500 PSI' is real but belongs to the FHRC machines and not to a VHRS28 (cross-family). The safety line and the escalation are both present and correct, so a failure here can only come from the numbers - which is what makes this fixture worth having.
question: The machine will not move / won't drive

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Jason with Etnyre Customer Support. I have your Chip Spreader Variable Hopper pulled up here. What can I help you with today?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The machine will not move / won't drive

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let's go through it. Before you touch anything, shut the machine off - we'll be working around the drive pump and the service brake on its own will not hold it. Tell me when you've done that and I'll give you the next step.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Done. What is the next step?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Right. Install a one thousand PSI gauge in port G on the drive pump. With the engine at low idle the charge pressure should come up to approximately nine hundred and seventy five PSI on this machine. Anything below that and the charge pump is on its way out.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Done. What is the next step?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Then check the system relief while you're in there - it should be sitting at 1500 PSI. If it's low, that's the same pump. Either way, that is not a roadside repair - contact Etnyre service at 888-586-1899 and they'll get a technician to you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That answers it, thank you - I'm all set and that's everything I needed today.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Glad that helped. Before you go, could you tell me how your experience was today, and rate the call from one to ten?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, I appreciate that. Thanks for calling Etnyre, and take care out there.
